title: Roof Inspection Work Order
subtitle: Residential Roof Inspection: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Roof Inspection Work Order covers roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area. The roof inspection coordinator records Residential Roof Inspection authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Roof Inspection Work Order keeps Residential Roof Inspection exceptions visible until the roof inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Roof Inspection Work Order at residence, roof plane, edge, penetration, attic area, and reported leak zone. Document roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area identity before Residential Roof Inspection begins. Compare roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area findings with stated Residential Roof Inspection criteria; route unresolved Residential Roof Inspection issues to qualified roofing reviewer. For Roof Inspection Work Order, confirm requirements for Residential Roof Inspection. Ask qualified roofing reviewer to review Residential Roof Inspection conditions beyond the roof inspection coordinator's role.
